# GSAP vendored runtime

- Upstream: https://github.com/greensock/GSAP
- Version: 3.15.0
- Browser entry: `dist/gsap.min.js`
- License: GreenSock standard no-charge license
- License text: https://gsap.com/standard-license

dsh-Remote keeps the fixed browser distribution local so the zero-build WebUI
does not depend on a CDN or runtime npm resolution.
